variables.name: mFillDelta
variables.comment: Time in ms it takes to generate one token.

variables.name: mCapacity
variables.comment: Maximum number of tokens that can be stored.

variables.name: mLastFill
variables.comment: Last time in ms the bucket generated tokens.

methods.name: public void reset(int tokens)
methods.comment: Reset this TokenBucket and set its number of available tokens.

methods.name: public int capacity()
methods.comment: Returns this TokenBucket maximum token capacity.

methods.name: public int available()
methods.comment: Returns this TokenBucket currently number of available tokens.

methods.name: public boolean has()
methods.comment: Returns true if this TokenBucket as one or more tokens available.

methods.name: public boolean get()
methods.comment: Consumes a token from this TokenBucket and returns true if a token is available.

* Try to consume many tokens from this TokenBucket.
